notes: Replaces nextjs-wazaby-web-137 as the pages-router-only cell. Wazaby has no test script and no CI at its base commit, so it fails the re-checker's test check and cannot be an L1 case; it is removed in the same change (eval/cases/REMOVED.json). Couchers-org/couchers is MIT. The web app lives at app/web and is pages-router only (app/web/pages, no app/web/app directory at base). PR #9893 upgrades next ^15.5.7 -> 16.4.0. The installed versions are the app/web/yarn.lock pins, 15.5.7 at base and 16.4.0 at merge, not the manifest range. There is no root lockfile; mobile packages do not depend on next, so the pin is unambiguous. The web package.json test script is jest, and the repo has .github/workflows at base. The jest script sets NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL itself via cross-env. Confirm whether the suite needs the local API before enabling L1. base_commit is the first parent of the merge commit.
